62:1.text: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allāh,
the Sovereign, the Pure, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

62:2.text: It is He who has sent among the unlettered
a Messenger from themselves reciting to them His verses and purifying them and teaching them the Book
- although they were before in clear error -

62:3.text: others of them who have not yet joined them. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

62:4.text: That is the bounty of Allāh, which He gives to whom He wills, and Allāh is the possessor of great bounty.

62:5.text: The example of those who were entrusted with the Torah and then did not take it on
is like that of a donkey who carries volumes
Wretched is the example of the people who deny the signs of Allāh. And Allāh does not guide the wrongdoing people.

62:6.text: Say, "O you who are Jews, if you claim that you are allies of Allāh, excluding the
people, then wish for death, if you should be truthful."

62:7.text: But they will not wish for it, ever, because of what their hands have put forth. And Allāh is Knowing of the wrongdoers.

62:8.text: Say, "Indeed, the death from which you flee - indeed, it will meet you. Then you will be returned to the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, and He will inform you about what you used to do."
